components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single brand action per row or form: Enroll, Certificate, Create account, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:42px; padding:0 18px; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); border:1px solid transparent; font:600 0.95rem/1 var(--font-text, 'Red Hat Text', sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, transform .15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--brand, #b12c63); color:var(--brand-ink, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--brand-hover, #be377d); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #fe61f8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:var(--line, #4e1e52); color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary actions: Sign in, Try again, Clear filters.

components.name: Danger Button

components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); border:1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--danger, #ca3f56) 60%, transparent); background:transparent; color:var(--danger-text, #e99a9f); font:600 0.875rem/1 var(--font-text, 'Red Hat Text', sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { background:var(--danger, #ca3f56); border-color:var(--danger, #ca3f56); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #fe61f8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; width:300px; } .ds-search svg { position:absolute; left:13px; color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); pointer-events:none; } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px 0 38px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #55225a); border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:var(--bg-sunken, #22041d); color:var(--text, #fff4fb); font:400 1rem/1.55 var(--font-text, 'Red Hat Text', sans-serif); caret-color:var(--active, #fe61f8); transition:border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--focus, #fe61f8); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--focus, #fe61f8) 30%, transparent); }

components.name: Day Rail
components.description: Signature wayfinding: season days in Mono with counts on a deep purple spine; a magenta marker glides to the day in view.
components.css: .ds-rail { --row:46px; position:relative; width:196px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; border-left:1px solid var(--line-strong, #55225a); } .ds-rail::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:-1px; top:0; width:3px; height:var(--row); background:var(--active, #fe61f8); border-radius:0 2px 2px 0; transform:translateY(calc(var(--day, 0) * var(--row))); transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-rail button { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:100%; height:var(--row); padding:0 4px 0 18px; border:0; background:none; color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); font:500 0.82rem/1 var(--font-mono, 'Red Hat Mono', monospace); letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:color .15s ease; } .ds-rail button:hover, .ds-rail button.on { color:var(--text, #fff4fb); } .ds-rail button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #fe61f8); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-rail span { min-width:22px; padding:3px 6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--bg-raised, #310a2e); color:var(--text-2, #ffd3ee); font-size:.72rem; text-align:center; } .ds-rail .on span { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--active, #fe61f8) 22%, transparent); color:var(--text, #fff4fb); }

components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:76px minmax(0,1fr) 190px 112px; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:20px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #4e1e52); color:var(--text, #fff4fb); font-family:var(--font-text, 'Red Hat Text', sans-serif); transition:background-color .15s ease; } .ds-row:hover { background:var(--bg-raised, #310a2e); } .ds-time { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; align-self:start; font:600 1rem/1 var(--font-mono, 'Red Hat Mono', monospace); color:var(--time, #5be0f0); } .ds-time small { font-weight:400; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); } .ds-time code { margin-top:6px; font:500 .7rem/1 var(--font-mono, 'Red Hat Mono', monospace); letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--text-3, #c1a0c7); } .ds-row h3 { margin:0; font:700 1.1rem/1.15 var(--font-display, 'Red Hat Display', sans-serif); } .ds-row p { margin:6px 0 0; color:var(--text-2, #ffd3ee); font-size:.92rem; } .ds-meter { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--text-2, #ffd3ee); } .ds-meter strong { color:var(--text, #fff4fb); font:600 .9rem/1 var(--font-mono, 'Red Hat Mono', monospace); } .ds-track { height:6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--seat-track, #481949); overflow:hidden; } .ds-fill { height:100%; border-radius:inherit; background:var(--seat, #5be0f0); } .ds-enroll { min-height:42px; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px); background:var(--brand, #b12c63); color:var(--brand-ink, #fff); font:600 .95rem/1 var(--font-text, 'Red Hat Text', sans-serif); cursor:pointer; } .ds-enroll:hover { background:var(--brand-hover, #be377d); } .ds-enroll:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus, #fe61f8); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Night Agenda"**

InfectionSkillHub reads like a city's cultural agenda printed for the evening: the season's workshops filed under their day, each day opened by a large day numeral over a raspberry rule, times standing in a fixed mono column at the left, seats shown as a short meter, and the action at the row's end. It is a listing, not a marketplace: there are no cards, no hero, no photography. Density is that of a printed programme, generous between days (48px) and tight within a row.

The world is nocturnal by default. Dark mode is the eggplant ground with deep purple rules; light mode is the same agenda printed on pink-tinted stock with eggplant ink, not a separate design. Both themes are derived from one pinned eight-color palette; every other color in the build is a `color-mix(in oklab, ...)` of two palette colors (or a palette color and white or black), or an `oklch(from ...)` adjustment of one. Personality lives in the details (the glyph-free calendar mark, the gliding magenta rail marker, the mono figures) and never at the cost of legibility.

Theme resolution: the saved choice in `localStorage` (`infectionskillhub.theme`), else `prefers-color-scheme`, applied on `<html data-theme>` before first paint. `:root` alone resolves to dark. Color tokens prefixed `night-` belong to dark, `stock-` to light; the palette tokens are shared.
keyCharacteristics: Agenda rows under day headings; hairline dividers instead of containers.
One eggplant-and-raspberry world in two printings (night and pink stock).
Scarce accents with fixed jobs: cyan for times, seats and confirmation, magenta for the active day and focus, coral for full, cancelled and error.
Red Hat superfamily: Display for headings, Text for reading, Mono for every figure.
Flat print surfaces; the only shadow belongs to the floating toast.
One motion moment (the rail marker), one settle (seat meters), all removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Eight Inks Rule
rules.body: Every color is one of the eight pinned palette colors or a `color-mix(in oklab, ...)` / `oklch(from ...)` derivation of them, with white and black allowed only as mixing endpoints and as ink on raspberry or coral. No new hue enters the system.

rules.name: The Fixed Jobs Rule
rules.body: Cyan means time, open seats and confirmation; magenta means "you are here" (active day, focus); coral means stopped (full, cancelled, error, destructive). An accent never decorates.

rules.name: The One World, Two Printings Rule
rules.body: Light mode is the night agenda reprinted on pink stock with eggplant ink. Every role token exists in both themes; never style a component for one theme only.

rules.name: The Mono For Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, workshop codes, seat numbers, counts and rail dates are set in Red Hat Mono. Words are never set in Mono except the uppercase date and count labels that belong to a figure.

rules.name: The Heavy Numeral Rule
rules.body: Display weight 800 is reserved for day numerals, the page h1, the wordmark and the auth masthead. Everything else stays at 700 or lighter.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page surface casts a shadow. A shadow means the element floats above the agenda (a toast); a blur means it is pinned (a sticky bar).

dos: **Do** file every list of workshops or enrollments under day headings as rows: Mono time column at left, content, then state and action at the row's end.
**Do** derive any new color as `color-mix(in oklab, ...)` of two palette colors (or a palette color with white or black) and define it for both `[data-theme='dark']` and `[data-theme='light']`.
**Do** set times, codes, counts and seat figures in Red Hat Mono, and keep body text on tabular numerals.
**Do** pair every status color with a word and an icon (Full, Enrolled, Active, Cancelled); color repeats state, it never carries it alone.
**Do** keep destructive actions outlined in coral until hovered or focused, and at least 28px from the nearest sibling action.
**Do** use the 2px magenta focus outline at 2px offset on every interactive element; inputs use the focus border plus 3px halo instead.
**Do** confine motion to the rail marker glide, the seat settle, the switch knob and the toast rise, all on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and keep the global `prefers-reduced-motion` override.
donts: **Don't** introduce a grid of identical workshop cards; the agenda row is the only listing container.
**Don't** add a ninth hue or a raw hex outside the palette; white and black appear only as mixing endpoints and as ink on raspberry or coral.
**Don't** use cyan, magenta or coral decoratively; each has one job (time, seats and confirmation; active day and focus; stopped).
**Don't** put shadows on page surfaces; only floating toasts cast one.
**Don't** fabricate photography, testimonials or logos; the calendar mark is the only image.
**Don't** style a component for one theme only; light is the same agenda on pink stock.
